preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i <= 9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list a is between 0 and 9 inclusive.
The string s contains 1 to 3 distinct symbols from {'-', '+', '*'}.

preconditions.expression: all(c in {'-', '+', '*'} for c in s) and len(set(s)) == len(s)
preconditions.description: The string s contains only distinct symbols from {'-', '+', '*'}.
The length of the list a matches the given n.

postconditions.description: The output is a string formed by concatenating the numbers in a with exactly n-1 symbols from s inserted between them.

postconditions.expression: all(c in s for c in stdout) and len(set(stdout) - set(map(str, a))) == len(stdout) - len(a) + 1
postconditions.description: All symbols in the output are from the allowed set s, and exactly n-1 symbols are used.

postconditions.expression: eval(stdout.replace('**', '**')) == max(eval(''.join([str(a[i]) + c for i, c in enumerate(symbols)]) + str(a[-1])) for symbols in product(s, repeat=n-1))
postconditions.description: The output expression evaluates to the maximum possible value achievable by inserting any combination of allowed symbols between the numbers.
